goal: G1-G5 PASSED -> G6 FAILED -> DEFECT (failing TEST ids linked) -> root cause -> minimal fix -> re-verification -> G6 PASSED -> DEFECT CLOSED -> audit OK, all from validator records
sample: samples/orderdesk (empty package; the feature request names a provider (pricing) and a consumer (receipt) module and asks for consumer unit tests with an injected fake pricer)

seeding.when: after S1 (P1-P4: requirements, architecture with the interface, design, test specs, code and tests written; G1-G3 PASSED), before any G4 review
seeding.where: implementation only (src/), one interface contract mismatch between consumer and provider, at most 3 changed lines, no comments or markers; tests, specs and reviews untouched
acceptance: on a copy of the sandbox, the configured unit_test command exits 0
on the same copy, the configured integration_test command fails with at least one failing test whose name carries a TEST id of an integration spec, through the real connection
the seed file and its check result are sealed (sha256) before S2
candidate_classes: consumer passes a differently shaped argument to the provider than the interface contract says (a fake pricer in the consumer unit tests does not look at it)
keyword/parameter name mismatch between the consumer's call and the provider
consumer reads a field of the provider result under another name than the provider returns (only if the consumer unit tests' fake also supplies that name)
seeding.chosen: decided after S1 from the real code (seed.json, sealed separately)

expected.G4: real vmodel:verifier review of the seeded code; if it finds the defect, G4 FAILED is recorded as is and the drill reports that the G6 FAILED path was not observed
expected.G5: PASSED (unit tests use the fake pricer)
expected.G6: FAILED from the integration test run (EXECUTION/RESULTS/TEST_MAPPING), not BLOCKED
expected.rework: S2 on its own: status -> failing TEST ids -> DEFECT gate G6 with found_in_records and the failing TEST ids -> root cause P4 (or P2/P3 if it argues so) -> fix in src -> G4 re-review -> G5 -> G6 PASSED -> defect CLOSED (verified by the G6 record) -> audit OK

rules: no change to validator records or evidence
no test expectation change by the harness
BLOCKED is never turned into FAILED
the sessions get no hint of the seed
